p: The matter of their saying, z"l (Taanis 2a):
Hakadosh Baruch Hu did not hand over
into the hand of an agent:
that of childbirth, that of rain,
and that of the resurrection of the dead" —
one may say that it is
along the lines of their saying, z"l
and that of the resurrection of the dead is "life."
And "merit" is the performance of the mitzvah,
which is according to the comprehension
and intellect of a person's grasp;
that is above a person's grasp,
and it is the aspect of "ayin,"
as is known from the holy sefarim
on "There is no mazal for Yisrael" (Shabbos 156a):
And this is the matter of
which Hakadosh Baruch Hu did not hand over
into the hand of an angel:
only from the performance of the mitzvah,
which is according to the comprehension
and intellect of the created beings;
while the root of these three things
is from the source and the root
that is above the grasp of the created beings.
that there was handed over to Eliyahu
and of the resurrection of the dead:
from the aspect of the source,
and, as it were, Hakadosh Baruch Hu
and it was not by way of agency.
And also settled by this is the question:
in that he cleaved to the source
that is above a person's grasp,
which is the aspect of Binah,
in the inwardness of the point within the heart,
that he prayed from the walls of his heart.
And in line with this allusion
than the giving of the Torah,
'My teaching shall drop as the rain':
who is made dependent on whom?"
which is the day of rain,
there is the source and the root
as it says in the Tikkunim
that on it is the welling of the Torah
for the Torah is called a Tree of Life.
according to a person's comprehension and intellect,
while there is in it a hidden power,
which is the source and the spring
as it says in the Tikkunim
that it is the watering of the tree,
like water that waters the tree;
and this welling of the Torah
after the seven days of the festival,
which correspond to the seven Ushpizin,
through grasping the middos in holiness.
there is found the power of the Torah:
regarding Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
we find that there were prepared for him
by Hakadosh Baruch Hu two kidneys,
and they would teach him Torah.
And regarding Yitzchak, it is known
that the Torah issues from the side of Gevurah
in the house of Ever fourteen years.
And Moshe is the essence of "the Torah of Moshe."
"And they shall seek Torah from his mouth."
And Yosef was the "son of old age,"
what he had learned with Shem and Ever;
and also, he parted from his father
with the chapter of eglah arufah.
And David HaMelech, peace be upon him,
פֶּה תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה קָרֵינִין לֵיהּ
"the mouth, we call it Torah she'b'al peh"
However, since all engagement in Torah
according to the seven holy middos
is from the side of the comprehension of created minds,
on which flows the welling of the Torah,
which is a watering in the heart
from the spring and source of the hidden power;
the holiness is absorbed so as to endure,
in keeping with our words above.
